name: withDensity_ofReal_mutuallySingular
statement: α → ℝ} (hf : Measurable f) : (μ.withDensity fun x => ENNReal.ofReal <| f x) ⟂ₘ μ.withDensity fun x => ENNReal.ofReal <| -f x

name: aemeasurable_withDensity_ennreal_iff'
statement: α → ℝ≥0} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) {g : α → ℝ≥0∞} : AEMeasurable g (μ.withDensity fun x => (f x : ℝ≥0∞)) ↔ AEMeasurable (fun x => (f x : ℝ≥0∞) * g x) μ
